notes.title: Devlog | July Update & Demo Release!
notes.notes:
[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeDtk7lMk1oCDlG1hKZGlvbl-5KfVUvigDcjDtgIXk_-ZJFpBHifGQd1PHnPcr1Yujpha2Gl-Emb-CbTdinao0wsl_C2RTdU5t4Xpgj9mG2L_7qHRusoDLsk47hhG5j5MnNpRx5Wg?key=9BtPgX_y4wXx17kk0V4KsQ"]



Hi everyone,  

BIG NEWS: OUR DEMO IS OUT!

If you haven’t tried it yet, now’s a great time. And if you have, make sure to hop into our Discord to tell us what you think (or just to hang out).  

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcW-cTeTaZtxiOKnnbWpP5iIkvAcA_81lAVKmrofDbqKBP5QOxN4Xc1ly5IxUt5OKB94clMLds3cE5XVVi0cwV41ZiavQHS-smlPcNAmKYxhjAf-EM_sgjwCJvpntr-1qiRo4a7zQ?key=9BtPgX_y4wXx17kk0V4KsQ"]

Now for some recent-ish and super cool updates:


Llama and Slime Bosses
The long-awaited new bosses have arrived! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/1bad156f2e402bb73d6cfc221197154128be9257.png"]

They might look cute, but can you dodge their deadly fire meteors, ice pillars, revolving fireballs, projectiles, arm smashes, AND MORE? Sounds pretty difficult to us…

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/4197d1d3567148e37ada8f755e262a5dc913db70.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/4ad08646a82fad62c113626d94eb3da4a1abfb12.gif"]


Environment Color Theming
We added some pizzazz as you progress through your run - map palettes now change depending on the round number.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/81804c8c037952f2f912dc9d311fcea0e31f7689.png"]
GIANT Shopkeeper
The bigger the cat, the more magical. That’s just how it works.

We also made their spawns more accessible!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/f548174f096d8ce703c6ea5058b32e9289c1eb18.gif"]


Discovered by: YOU
If you’re the first player to discover a new spell, your Steam ID now shows in its tooltip. 

Show off your wizarding skills - how many can you uncover?

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/c37f4edc505ef20b6e24eebc75341182920eeeac.png"]


Frog Mini Boss
MINI boss but MEGA abilities.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdZh5NxaAN3Kc9AUQz8rv79XLOBIuyqmS8fgx_niC4dRdvl4uop9EpnFED06u63hEDN0OicBqHBk1LsjFRFPsLWfmmUmmyiB-62m-oOId5KtLmFeAZYIMLmwkeetdIsfqExVmJyug?key=9BtPgX_y4wXx17kk0V4KsQ"]


Metaprogression
Boss damage now scales over time.

You can unlock new difficulty levels after beating Round 21:

Novice → Apprentice → Initiate → Acolyte → Mage → Master Mage → Archmage


Other New Features
Monsters-Killed Gold Charge Bar: Kill thresholds at 20, 40, 60, and 80 percent of a round's total spawn power. Earn 1 gold per threshold. Kill 80 percent, get 4 gold.

Blink Spell: Teleporting Cat? Teleporting Cat.

Training Dummy: Spawns in the starting world and after each round ends.

Monster Spawn Indicator: No more jumpscares when enemies appear - indicators are now shown on the ground.

Key Bindings: Fully customizable in the options menu.

UI Animations: Made the UI more interactive and intuitive! For example, when you pick up an arcana, there is a glowing animation around your arcana equip slots. Our favorite is the slot-up animation, which teases you a bit if it fails. 



Thanks as always for following our development - stay tuned for more awesome updates!

notes.title: Devlog | June Update
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/d4562601eb735514abbd47e75f95737e4e3210a1.gif"]

Hey everyone, excited to start sharing regular dev updates here on Steam! Here are some highlights from the last couple months.

Frog King Boss
Introducing our first boss, the Frog King Boss! Kill him before he slams you with his belly.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/6a56eabe8ae558e87ae3a811df4a814f1e528675.gif"]
Buff Frog Enemy
New enemy! Buff frog who charges at you, thick boy walks with confidence…

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/32f533aa0c9f51757ff41566c90d34f04ccb8894.gif"]
Combined Inventory, Crafting, and Shop View
A piece of feedback from playtesters was improving the UI, making it more intuitive with more info in tooltips.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/641d5f277c359d6b9f50ad9977085795149d7eda.png"]
Twin Stick Movement
We’ve upgraded movement system to twin stick movement, combat feels quite a bit smoother now!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160321/ac93c158d923e749ea1796ee7d57f666134920e0.gif"]


New Arcana and Balance Updates
Some of the arcana we added to encourage new builds and also address some feedback about a shortage of early game arcana:

Voltanic eruption: +5% increased fire damage for every lightning strike spawned in the past 5 seconds

Coin clicker: gain 1 gold at end of round for every 3 times this spell is cast (max 5 gold)

Single target: 100% increased damage, but this halves every time the spell damages a new target

Flameo: on cast, other spells gain +15 base fire damage for the next 10 seconds. does not stack

Re-ignite/re-charge/re-freeze: -1 fire/lightning/ice reduced mana cost

Also nerfed several existing arcana and other balance updates, shout out to all of our early playtesters for letting us know where we need to make adjustments!

What’s Next
Metaprogression

Two Headed Llama and Giant Slime bosses

More UI improvements

Blink spells



Thanks for following development, stay tuned for more updates!
